proposals.subject: Limulus polyphemus
proposals.title: I had not meant to leave
proposals.body:
My tail kept finding sand that would not hold. I pushed, rolled a little, and came back onto my shell.

Then something took hold of my rim.

Folded my legs tight. I had been trying to turn over, but I had not meant to leave the beach.

The sand came back under my feet. The grip was gone.

Put one foot down. Then all the others. I kept expecting another lift. Got all the way into the water on my own feet.

proposals.alt: An Atlantic horseshoe crab lies upside down on wet sand, with folded dark legs, its broad underside and long straight tail visible.
proposals.fictionBoundary: The primary observer reports finding the animal stranded upside down, turning it over, and seeing it walk toward water. Images show both orientations. The failed tail push, handling by the rim, defensive folding timing, fear of being carried away, incremental first steps and entering the water are fictional elaborations. Neither hands nor the lift is visible in the selected frame. The observer documents movement toward water, not final entry.
proposals.continuity: Existing adult male Hugo, as established by AQUATIC-VISUAL-30-ADMISSION.md, rather than the older unassigned-sex26 proposal. Source03 has rounded, enlarged anterior grasping appendages consistent with adult male claspers; source does not explicitly identify sex. No sex proof is claimed from body size. Source is southern New Jersey, not Jamaica Bay. This casts a same-species Atlantic coastal animal in a compatible shoreline scene and does not establish a real migration or photographed New York locality.
proposals.placement: Final lead decision: before Unwilling passengers and Finding the rim; preserve both bodies and adult profile/avatar. Earlier rescue source precedes heavier attached shells without inventing lost companions.
proposals.narrativeAssessment: A failed effort to regain control is interrupted by an alarming lift. Being set down restores agency, but relief arrives one step at a time. This develops Hugo’s fear of restraint through an actual source-documented rescue, without another passenger complaint or mating grip.
reviewFlags: Same-coast regional casting requires lead acceptance; source location is explicitly New Jersey.
Lead should independently check male-compatible anterior appendages.
Only source03 is proposed as Story media. Sources01/02 corroborate the same incident and are not separate stories.
